properties.description: Nanostructured material containing Ni, Mo, S, O, likely NiMoS or similar layered structure

nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of NiMoS
nodes.procedure: 0.07 M Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.01 M (NH4)Mo7O24·4H2O and 0.30 M thiourea were dissolved into 15 mL deionized water and stirred for 10 min under room temperature. Then the solution was transferred to a 25 mL Teflon-lined steel autoclave with nickel foam. After hydrothermal reaction at 200°C for 24 h, NiMoS precursor was obtained through washing with deionized water and then dried in an oven at 60°C.

nodes.name: Oxidation/hydrogenation of NiMoS
nodes.procedure: As-obtained NiMoS precursors were irradiated by RF plasma under an oxygen flow (RF power, 50~150 W) for the oxidation treatment. Afterward the arrays were annealed up to 300-500°C in H2/Ar (0.05/0.95) for the typical hydrogenation regulation, thus resulting into the synthesis of NiMoOx/NiMoS heterostructure array by oxidation/hydrogenation-induced surface reconfiguration strategy.

nodes.source_text: The electrocatalytic performance of various arrays in the three-electrode system was conducted through a linear scan voltammogram (LSV) in 1 M KOH solution at 25 °C... NiMoO_x / NiMoS array delivers the current densities of 10, 100, and 500 mA cm^-2 at the low overpotentials of 38, 89 and 174 mV, respectively, even requiring a low overpotential of 236 mV at a large current density of 1000 mA cm^-2 towards HER (Fig. 5b)... the lowest Tafel slope... 38 mV per decade... time-dependent current density curves confirm that there is no obvious change upon the current densities of 100 and 500 mA cm^-2 at 0.089 and 0.174 V vs. RHE over 50 h (Fig. 5d)... Faradaic efficiency of 99.6±0.3%

NiMoOx/NiMoS array exhibits the best OER performance among all arrays... presents the low overpotentials of 186, 225, and 278 mV at current densities of 10, 100, and 500 mA cm^-2, and delivers a large current density of 1000 mA cm^-2 at 334 mV towards OER (Fig. 6b)... the lowest Tafel slope, 34 mV per decade... the largest C_dl value of 21.5 mF cm^-2... can preserve OER activities at 100 and 500 mA cm^-2 with the potentials of 1.455 and 1.508 V vs. RHE over 50 h (Fig. 6d)... nodes.characterization_summary: NiMoS-based arrays show characteristic peaks of MoS₂ phase (JCPDS No. 37-1492) and Ni₃S₂ phase (JCPDS No. 44-1418). After oxidation/hydrogenation treatment, MoO₃ (JCPDS No.47-1320), MoO₂ (JCPDS No. 50-0739), and NiO (JCPDS No.44-1159) phases are observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To determine the crystal structure, X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of NiMoS-based arrays are showed (Supplementary Fig. 2). ... confirming the formation of individual MoS₂ and Ni₃S₂ as well as MoS₂/Ni₃S₂ heterostructure as the precursors.

nodes.characterization_summary: MoS₂ nanosheets have average size over 1 μm. NiMoS shows 2D MoS₂ nanosheets (size <1 μm) attached to 1D Ni₃S₂ nanorods. NiMoOx/NiMoS maintains morphology with smaller, rougher MoS₂ nanosheets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To confirm the geometric morphologies of individual arrays by scanning electron microscope (SEM), as shown in Fig. 2a, d, MoS₂ nanosheets as the precursor with an average size over 1 μm ... the small size and rough surface of MoS₂ nanosheets in NiMoOx/NiMoS array are observed.

properties.description: Structure with MoS2 and lattice spacing

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX spectra show MoOx/MoS₂ molar content of about 6.1% with homogeneous element distribution in NiMoOx/NiMoS array.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Meanwhile, the energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectra and elemental mapping ... indicate the molar content of MoOₓ/MoS₂ about 6.1% and the homogeneous element distribution in NiMoOx/NiMoS array.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms MoS₂ and MoOₓ/MoS₂ nanosheets attached to Ni₃S₂ and NiOₓ/Ni₃S₂ nanorods. HRTEM shows lattice fringes of 0.62 nm (002) MoS₂, 0.33 nm (011) MoO₃, 0.246 nm (100) MoO₂, 0.41 nm (101) Ni₃S₂, 0.113 nm (112) NiOₓ.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To check the details of the morphology, transition electron microscope (TEM) and high-resolution TEM observations verify the architectures ... the characteristic lattice fringes of 0.62, 0.33, and 0.246 nm can be assigned to the (002) plane of MoS₂, (011) plane of MoO₃, and (100) plane of MoO₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: Elemental mappings confirm uniform distribution of Ni, Mo, S, and O elements in NiMoOx/NiMoS heterostructures.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Moreover, the elemental mappings by high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) confirm the uniform distribution of Ni, Mo, S, and O.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMoOx/NiMoS shows Mo 3d peaks at 229.3, 232.4, 235.5 eV indicating Mo⁴⁺/Mo⁶⁺ from MoOₓ formation, Ni 2p peaks shifted with new peaks at 854.6 and 852.6 eV indicating Ni-O bonds and metallic Ni⁰ from NiOₓ, O 1s at 529.5 and 531.5 eV for metal-oxygen bonds and oxygen vacancies, S 2p negative shift indicating S vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For Ni 2p orbitals, there is a shift upon the peak positions and the two new peaks at 854.6 and 852.6 eV, demonstrating the existence of Ni–O bonds and metallic Ni⁰ and the formation of NiOₓ species in NiMoOₓ/NiMoS. Typically, the signals at 529.5 and 531.5 eV for O 1s belong to typical metal-oxygen bonds and oxygen vacancies ... With regard to S 2p peaks, the negative shift is observed ... demonstrating the loss of S and the formation of S vacancies.
